## Requirements: Git History continuation-failure browser coverage

### Problem and verified baseline

The product fix for #4116 (silent Git History older-page failure) merged via child #4141 / PR #4145: `useGitHistoryPagination` settles a rejected continuation behind the #3751 target/generation/request fences, and `GitHistoryCommitList` renders a retryable `role="alert"` notice beside Load older. The parent #4116 still requires its SCN-02 Chromium proof at the exact shipped SHA; the green E2E run on PR #4145 selected no Git History scenario (`E2E selection mode: not-required`). The #4116 owner's 2026-11-20 comment directs exactly this extension as the next bounded task.

The canonical `e2e/tests/browser/fixture-git.spec.ts` History surface (#826) only asserts the default three-commit repository, and the `git=history-overlap` fixture (#3751) can hold and release the first older read but has no way to settle it as a rejection. A rejected continuation, its retry, and a stale-Session rejection are therefore not executable in the canonical browser lane.

### Scope

- Extend the existing `git=history-overlap` fixture surface so the Case can release the held older read as a rejection (`releaseOlder(true)`), keeping the default resolve behavior unchanged for the existing #3751/#3767 Cases.
- Add two deterministic tests to the existing `fixture-git.spec.ts`: a rejected continuation retains commits/cursor, renders the retryable alert, and a retry appends the page once, with a browser `unhandledrejection` observer; and a stale Session's rejected continuation publishes nothing into the successor.
- No production behavior change, no new spec file, no protocol/Agent change.

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 The canonical fixture-git suite at the exact PR head passes a deterministic rejected-continuation scenario: the loaded page and cursor survive, a retryable alert is rendered beside the enabled Load older control, the retry appends the expected page exactly once and clears the alert, and a browser unhandled-rejection observer records nothing.
- [ ] SC-02 The same suite passes a stale-Session rejection scenario — a failed older page held for the previous Session publishes no error and no loading-state change into the successor, whose own continuation still appends once — and every pre-existing fixture-git test remains green.

**SC → scenario:** SC-01 and SC-02 → SCN-02 (Chromium browser interaction in the Issue-selected canonical E2E lane at exact PR head; deterministic fixture controls, no timers).
